# `aitbc ai refund-sweep`

Refund all client-owned AI jobs stuck in an incomplete state.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc ai refund-sweep [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--limit` | integer | `100` | no | Maximum completed jobs to inspect |
| `--reason` | text | `buyer_requested` | no | Reason for refund |
| `--dry-run` | flag | `false` | no | Count candidates without refunding |
| `--coordinator-url` | text | — | no | Coordinator URL |
| `--format` | choice | — | no | Output format |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc ai refund-sweep
```
